messages:
support_jane: Prod support ticket — multiple customers seeing increased 5xx/gateway errors on /v1/infer since ~11:02 PST. Escalating to oncall. :rotating_light:
deploy-bot: deploy started: apirouter canary toggle `header-truncate=true` by eli_eng at 11:00 PST (canary=5%)
oncall_mike: looking. Are 5xx coming from apirouter or upstream auth/service?
monitoring-bot: 5xx rate (5m avg) for apirouter -> 18% (baseline 0.3%). P95 latency up 400ms. Error spread by route: /v1/infer and billing webhook proxy.
support_jane: here's a repro curl from a customer (sanitized):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer long-token==" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-xl","input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer
```
eli_eng: i can repro in prod-canary nodes. apirouter started dropping/truncating headers for long auth tokens — those requests are hitting auth facade which returns an unexpected null and then 500 when downstream tries to read claims.
priya_sre: stack snippet from auth-facade on canary: 
```
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address
  at auth/facade.go:142 -> claims = req.Header.Get("Authorization")[0:32]
```
priya_sre: not ideal — code assumes header length and slices it. The canary header middleware now forces shorter header slices, causing panic leading to 500s.
oncall_mike: this matches customer timeline (11:02). So canary flag flip looks like root cause. We should rollback canary and stop traffic to those canary nodes.
billing-team: customers are also seeing billing webhook 502s when we proxy to billing-service; likely same path. We're getting PagerAlerts from a large customer.
eli_eng: proposed mitigation: revert `header-truncate=false` in apirouter flag group, restart canary pool, and throttle canary traffic to 0% while we patch auth-facade to be defensive.
oncall_mike: agree. Who can flip the flag? eli?
eli_eng: I can flip now. Doing `rb experimental apirouter --flag header-truncate=false --scope canary`
eli_eng: done. deploy-bot: flag updated in config-store for canary at 11:15 PST (audit id 0x9f1a).
monitoring-bot: 5xx rate starting to decline in the last minute; 5m avg down to 6%. P95 latency recovering.
support_jane: relaying to customers: "We rolled back a canary header change that caused downstream auth panics; we're monitoring. If you still have issues, please share a failing request id." :white_check_mark:
priya_sre: next steps: 1) patch auth-facade slicing logic to check header length (PR in progress by eli), 2) add a defensive middleware to apirouter to reject too-short headers gracefully, 3) improve canary gating to run integration smoke before allowing header-affecting flags.
eli_eng: creating PR now: `fix/auth-header-guard` — will include unit + integration test against long token shapes.
oncall_mike: notify infra and paging in case any rollbacks need escalated capacity: @infra oncall please standby.
billing-team: still seeing a few 502s for retry bursts, but reduced. Communicated to customers with note about root cause and rollback.
eli_eng: once PR merged, propose staged rollout with 1% -> 5% -> 25% with smoke tests verifying infer and billing proxy routes for 10m each.
priya_sre: filing a short incident report and postmortem template. tagging this P1->internal incident.
support_jane: closing the active customer escalations for now — will reopen if errors persist. Thanks everyone. :pray:
